title: Arithmetic circuit syntax
statement: For a coefficient type $F$ and input-index type $\iota$, an arithmetic circuit is generated by input wires indexed by $\iota$, public constants from $F$, sums of two circuits, scalar multiples of a circuit by a public coefficient, and products of two circuits.
